title: Chapter 2: Regaining Control
paragraphs: Long Tian sat cross-legged on the threadbare bed, inspecting the crippled meridians of his former self.
'To think I was this weak back then,' he muttered with a cold chuckle. 'No matter. With my thousand years of imperial experience, fixing these meridians will take less than three days.'
He formed a hand seal, invoking the Nine Dragons Qi Gathering Technique.
